questions.markdown:
Write a program using 3, 2, 1 and 0 address instructions for the following. Assume source and destination operands are memory locations. Write comments for each step.

$$
Y=(A-B)*(C+D)/E
$$
With the help of block diagram explain general register based computer organization and give suitable example instructions.
With the 11-bit instruction length and 4-bit address field, verify the possibility to have five 2-address, Forty five 1-address and thirty two 0-address instructions.
Explain the working of carry look ahead adder, Carry select adder and Carry save adder in detail.
Draw the Wallace tree structure for adding 7 single bit numbers. Give the advantage of having Wallace structure in the Execution unit.
Draw the Wallace tree structure for 7 single bit operand CSA. Write the expression for finding the number of CSA levels for the same.
Explain the method of non-restoring method of division with the help of a flow chart. Divide 7 by 3 using this method. Show all the iterations.
Add 0.5 and 0.4375 using 32-bit IEEE floating point representation and write the result in 32-bit IEEE format.

Build a hardware to implement each of the following register transfers. Assume A, B, C and X are 4-bit registers.

If X is even, then $A \leftarrow B\ \mathrm{OR}\ C$ else $A \leftarrow B\ \mathrm{AND}\ C$
Explain in detail standard I/O and memory-mapped I/O. Also explain programmed I/O approach for I/O communication.

A computer main memory consists of 1024 blocks of 256 words each. The cache memory has eight sets of each having four blocks(lines). Determine and show the tag field size of main memory address for the following mapping techniques. (i) Fully associative mapping, (ii) Direct mapping
A set associative cache consists of 64 slots divided into 4-slot sets. Main memory contains 4K blocks of 128 words each. Show the format of the main memory address.
Compare the architectural features of CISC, RISC and VLIW architectures.

A non-pipelined processor is operating at a clock rate of 2.5 GHz and average cycles per instruction of five. The processor is upgraded to a six-stage pipelined processor, but the clock speed for this processor is reduced to 2 GHz due to internal pipeline delay. If there are no stalls in the pipeline, then determine the speed up achieved in this pipeline processor.
Explain the characteristic features of three bus structure organization. Mention its advantages and disadvantages.
